questions.question: How many Premier League titles has Birthday boy Arsene Wenger won?
questions.explanation: 1997/98 – His first league title with Arsenal. 2001/02 – Arsenal completed the league and FA Cup Double. 2003/04 – The legendary Invincibles season, finishing unbeaten. During his entire tenure, he managed Arsenal in over 800 Premier League matches. His famous 2003/04 squad remains the only team in the history of the 38-game Premier League era to go an entire campaign without losing a single match.

questions.question: Which player holds the record for the most goals scored as a substitute in Premier League history?
